name: How do I choose the right contractor for storm damage repairs?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for storm damage repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for storm damage repairs, look for a company with a proven track record, positive local references, and proper licensing and insurance. It's important to choose a contractor familiar with insurance claims processes to ensure smooth coordination. Ask for a detailed, written estimate that clearly outlines the scope of work and materials. Maine Results, Inc. emphasizes transparency, provides comprehensive estimates, and actively assists clients through the insurance claim process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with a proven track record, local references, proper licensing, insurance, and experience with insurance claims.
